name: next-steps-jev
description: next-steps, with Jev scoring each suggested next prompt by how much it helps the current goal. Press 1, 2 or 3 to put one in the prompt box as a draft, 4 to 7 for two or three at once, 0 to dismiss.

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Your TypeSafe key for Jev scoring. Saved in secure storage. Leave empty to use the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable instead.

minAnswerChars.title: Shortest answer to suggest after
minAnswerChars.description: Skip suggestions after answers shorter than this many characters.

suggestSkills.title: Suggest skills and slash commands
suggestSkills.description: Tell the suggester which skills and slash commands this session has, so a suggestion can be one of them.
